entities.summary: Zachary Vincent LeDay is an American-born naturalized Azerbaijani professional basketball player player for Olimpia Milano of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A (LBA) and the EuroLeague. He played college basketball for the University of South Florida and Virginia Tech. At a height of 2.02 m tall, and a weight of 107 kg (235 lbs.), LeDay primarily plays at the power forward position.
